plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Noodle reads your workouts, sleep, weight and heart metrics — heart rate, resting heart rate, HRV, cardio fitness, blood pressure and blood oxygen — so it can show them in one place and compare them with your own earlier readings. It only reads; it never writes to Health.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Noodle does not write anything to Health.
